scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n client,server "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=client && npm run typecheck --workspace=server
scripts.test: npm run test:checkpoint --workspace=server && npm run test:storage --workspace=server && npm run test:runtime --workspace=server && npm run test:worker --workspace=server && npm run test:tools --workspace=server && npm run test:admission --workspace=server && npm run test:ledger --workspace=server && npm run test:api --workspace=server
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run contracts:compile && npm run test:signing && npm run test:local
